events.verdict: Jones (CHI) steps forward toward Green (HOU) and Green is able to spin off of the marginal body contact in the backcourt.
Jones (CHI) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Green (HOU) prior to any incidental contact occurring.
Huerter (CHI) is established in Brooks' (HOU) path and absorbs the marginal body contact as Brooks changes direction after his gather.
Vucevic (CHI) initiates contact across Green's (HOU) front during the driving shot attempt.

Green (HOU) steps forward into White (CHI) and initiates body contact that affects White's SQBR. The contact occurred before White gathered the ball, and the play was correctly deemed to be a non-shooting foul.
Vucevic (CHI) is retreating in Sengun's (HOU) path and absorbs the marginal body contact as the two come together after Sengun's gather.

Brooks (HOU) initiates contact with White's (CHI) front and left arm. The contact occurred prior to the start of White's upward shooting motion, and the play was correctly deemed to be a non-shooting foul.

Williams (CHI) moves in a straight line alongside Green's (HOU) path and absorbs the marginal body contact as Green cuts back toward him. Williams then brushes Green's left arm before cleanly blocking his driving shot attempt.
Williams (CHI) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Sengun (HOU) as simultaneous incidental contact occurs.
Jones (CHI) brings his hands forward toward Green's (HOU) front and marginal contact occurs during Green's put-back attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) re-establishes his screening position prior to marginal contact occurring with Holiday (HOU), which occurs simultaneously with the defensive switch.
Brooks (HOU) cleanly deflects the inbound pass away from Huerter (CHI).
Brooks (HOU) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with CHI.
Smith Jr. (HOU) is bringing his arms into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs as White (CHI) cuts back toward him during the driving shot attempt.
Huerter (CHI) commits a take foul on Holiday (HOU).
Tate (HOU) legally contests Jones' (CHI) driving shot attempt.
